P1.project_objective: Remove the per-row GDN snapshot-write cost from speculative verify on the 27B, A3B and Q38FN, and free recurrent-state memory at np > 1.
P1.implementation_ref: C17 ed5d94969 GDN kernels (one column per warp; F32/BF16 state, tree, GDN-ROWS, H15 variants); program.md L700 snapshot-floor learning; PR #31669 head 93252b852acc
P1.gap: Our verify path writes (1+n_rs_seq) recurrent snapshots per step (about 3.1 MB per layer per row on the 27B); the program learning calls this floor unavoidable; no replay path exists in the fork.
P1.operational_change: Port replay as default-off behind LLAMA_RS_REPLAY, gate it per served recipe, write the tree-replay design note, correct the learning, and run three zero-inference reads (UFH14-A7 re-scoped against C17 PFXC-A1, checkpoint cut counts, whether snapshot slots already hold the n-4 state) that price split-free checkpoints.
P1.benefit_direction: Lower verify-step cost and recurrent memory at np > 1 (inferred about 1% at np 1 on the MI210, larger at np 4; 1-8% per CPU round, unmeasured); output tokens must stay identical.
P1.execution_conditions: Implementation on llama.cpp-experimental from C17 only (production frozen); isolated GPU and CPU rows through rowflow; activation only through the champion fold gate.
P1.closure_basis: Split-free checkpoint prototype stays trigger prose (M2) until KPF-64-CUTS shows material cut cost and the port has landed.

P2.project_objective: Recover the host sampling and accept time that LLAMA_DEVICE_ACCEPT does not cover because production :8083 runs at temperature 1.
P2.implementation_ref: autokernel-loop.md AK-GAP-1-IDSORT (TOPK_FAST, packed key float_key<<32|~index) and AK-GAP-1-SAMPLE (greedy device accept) @ ac1347f; speculative-decoding.md DF2-PM L1887 (temp 0.6 / top-p 0.95 / top-k 20 recipe)
P2.gap: Device accept is greedy-only; no post-C17 measurement of the temp-1 host share exists; the CPU MTP round non-forward share (10-13%) is unattributed.
P2.operational_change: One GPU census, then a default-off device stochastic accept gated by SPEC-PIT.1; one CPU attribution pass with a conditional AVX-512 top-k port.
P2.benefit_direction: Lower per-step host time at temperature > 0; output distribution must pass SPEC-PIT.1.
P2.execution_conditions: Census on the C17 store binary (profile only); kernel on llama.cpp-experimental from C17; activation via the champion fold gate.

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 1. llama.cpp PR #31669 (GDN replay instead of snapshot rollback). Reported on RTX PRO 6000, Qwen3.8-27B Q8_0: recurrent-state memory -73/-85/-91% at n_rs_seq 3/7/15; batched verify +17.8..+34.5% at 8-32 seqs (8 tok/seq); DFlash2 llama-server +2.1/+7.9/+3.8% at 4/16/32 slots; Strix Halo HIP prefill +1.7/+0.9%. Hardware: CUDA plus other backends; the ggml-cuda path builds for HIP, unmeasured on gfx90a. Value: INF-50 DFlash2 np>1 verify and the GDN snapshot floor in the autokernel program.md learnings; Q8MF-V5I-NP-DECODE np-scaling. Extract: the performance principles themselves — data layout, tiling, wavefront mapping, LDS use, fusion, quant packing and dispatch rules. (Specifically: logging recurrent inputs plus recompute instead of state copies, trading data movement for compute.) Check: whether each principle works on the MI210 (gfx90a, CDNA2, wave64, 64 KB LDS, no FP8) or the Zen 5 EPYC CPU (AVX-512, NPS4).
steering_reconciliation.reason: Item 1 (PR #31669): extraction and MI210/Zen 5 checks done in the intake-2752 dive; planned as P1 (port, gate, design note, learning amendment).

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 2. llama.cpp PR #32520 (kv_rows variant of the vec flash-attention kernel). Reported on RTX PRO 6000 sm_120, Qwen3-4B: q8_0 KV 7.97 -> 3.02 ms/tok and bf16 9.10 -> 2.77 ms/tok with a 34k-token idle slot; f16 unchanged. A reviewer found mixed K/V pairs regress without an extra dispatch check. Hardware: NVIDIA only; the HIP variant compiles but is never dispatched, so it does not run on gfx90a. Value: INF-50 G3 (MI210 verify in the VEC flash-attention kernel), -kvu with quantized KV. Extract: the performance principles themselves — data layout, tiling, wavefront mapping, LDS use, fusion, quant packing and dispatch rules. (Specifically: row-list lookup as a template parameter, per-lane row ownership with shuffles, dispatch gating.) Check: whether each principle works on the MI210 (gfx90a, CDNA2, wave64, 64 KB LDS, no FP8) or the Zen 5 EPYC CPU (AVX-512, NPS4).
steering_reconciliation.reason: Item 2 (PR #32520): our C17 already avoids the F16 conversion via its own gather port; planned as P4 FAROWS-GATHER-SHARE with in-place reads trigger-gated (M2) and a v11 note (K3).

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 3. llama.cpp PR #32646 (Q1_0 8x8 block interleaving, AVX-512 GEMM / AVX2 GEMV). Reported on a Zen 5 9600X, llama2 7B Q1_0: pp512 43.57 -> 138.96 t/s with AVX-512 (+218.94%), tg128 -1.31%; perplexity about 848K for both base and PR. Hardware: Zen 5 AVX-512, so it runs on the EPYC. Value: repack/shuffle pattern for IQ4NL zmm and Q8_0-interleave seeds; the format itself is not usable.
steering_reconciliation.reason: Item 3 (PR #32646): the AVX-512 GEMM is a clone of our existing tile; planned as K4 notes (K27 template, NEW-6 idiom); the Q8_0 measurement is the existing Q8PK-GEMM-AB box.

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 4. SonicSampler (arXiv 2607.20475). Reported: up to 10x faster top-k (hierarchical two-stage), up to 16x on heterogeneous speculative workloads; fused logit processing, top-k/top-p/min-p and speculative verification in one batched kernel. Hardware: Triton on CUDA, CUDA-Graph oriented. Value: AutoKernel AK-GAP-1 TOPK_FAST (49.7x op) and the DFlash2 verify/sampling tail. Extract: the performance principles themselves — data layout, tiling, wavefront mapping, LDS use, fusion, quant packing and dispatch rules. (Specifically: the two-stage top-k over a 248k vocab exploiting low entropy, and vertical fusion of the sampling chain.) Check: whether each principle works on the MI210 (gfx90a, CDNA2, wave64, 64 KB LDS, no FP8) or the Zen 5 EPYC CPU (AVX-512, NPS4).
steering_reconciliation.reason: Item 4 (SonicSampler): two-stage top-k already landed as TOPK_FAST; the remaining lever is temp-1 device accept, planned as P2.

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 5. LazyWeights (arXiv 2611.17108). Reported: lossless Huffman coding of GPTQ/GGUF codes, 5.7-31.4% smaller than the best GGUF at 1%/3.5% perplexity budgets; Jetson Nano CPU 58-64% less time per token; ASIC unit up to 36% lower Orin latency. Hardware: Jetson, a 7 nm ASIC, and a Zynq FPGA. Value: INF-70 CPU decode roofline, CPU-NT-WEIGHT-STREAM (spare cores versus DRAM bandwidth). Extract: the performance principles themselves — data layout, tiling, wavefront mapping, LDS use, fusion, quant packing and dispatch rules. (Specifically: interleaved-lane entropy coding of quant codes and decode-on-demand before the GEMV.) Check: whether each principle works on the MI210 (gfx90a, CDNA2, wave64, 64 KB LDS, no FP8) or the Zen 5 EPYC CPU (AVX-512, NPS4).
steering_reconciliation.reason: Item 5 (LazyWeights): principles checked on both devices; after the operator challenge (seq 17) the lever is re-opened as P7: census, CPU decode microbenchmark, gfx90a stall-budget estimate, kernel only on a passing gate (M7).

Extract: the performance principles themselves — data layout, tiling, wavefront mapping, LDS use, fusion, quant packing and dispatch rules. Check: whether each principle works on the MI210 (gfx90a, CDNA2, wave64, 64 KB LDS, no FP8) or the Zen 5 EPYC CPU (AVX-512, NPS4).
steering_reconciliation.reason: Item 6 (27B draft): MI210 swap declined on the HBM floor; CPU probe is trigger prose M1; recipe note K1.

proposed_tasks.task_text: - [ ] **RS-REPLAY-PORT** [non-inference] Forward-port llama.cpp PR #31669 GDN input-log replay onto a fresh llama.cpp-experimental branch from champion C17 ed5d94969, one feature per commit: the op keep parameter and CPU replay, test-backend-ops cases, the replay loop in our gfx90a GDN kernel variants (F32 and BF16 state, tree, GDN-ROWS, H15), the replay-only launch before chunked prefill, and the pending-row and conv column-history memory side, default-off behind LLAMA_RS_REPLAY (intake-2752#record, intake-2771#record).

- [ ] **RS-REPLAY-GATE** [inference] Gate GDN input-log replay against snapshot rollback on the served speculative recipes: 27B DFlash2 at np 1 and np 4 and A3B MTP on the MI210, and Q38FN MTP on the CPU, measuring token identity, recurrent-state memory, tok/s and np 4 GDN kernel wall time at n_max 7 and 15; the identity gate applies only to F32 raw-input logs replayed in the same order, any F16 or reordered variant is gated by KLD instead (intake-2752#record, intake-2771#record).

- [ ] **DTREE-REPLAY-DESIGN** [non-inference] Write the tree-replay design note: log per-column GDN inputs during tree verify and replay only the accepted path at llama_memory_tree_accept instead of keeping one recurrent snapshot per tree slot, and estimate the round-cost change against the measured DTREE-ROUND-OVERHEAD-2 gap (intake-2752#record).

- [ ] **AK-LEARN-GDN-REPLAY** [non-inference] Amend two learnings in the AutoKernel program.md: the GDN snapshot-write floor is avoidable by input-log replay (the remaining floor is one state write per step), and the tree cost model holds exactly only when a is the fractional increase in accepted tokens per round, with TALON's drafter-side term noted (intake-2752#record, intake-2769#record).

- [ ] **FR-UFH14-DIVERGE** [non-inference] Re-scope UFH14-A7 against champion C17, which already checkpoints at end of generation (PFXC-A1, default on; the UFH14-A7 code read was v10), and classify the 41 divergent turns by where the first divergence starts relative to the previous assistant output, to decide whether anything beyond PFXC-A1 is needed (intake-2758#record, intake-2772#record, intake-2787#record).

- [ ] **KPF-64-CUTS** [non-inference] Count checkpoint-induced extra ubatches (prefill cuts) per request and their wall time from existing llama-server -lv 4 logs of the served recipes, to price split-free checkpointing (intake-2758#record, intake-2787#record).

- [ ] **KPF-64-SNAPSLOT-READ** [non-inference] Code-read on C17 whether, with speculation on (n_rs_seq >= 4), the last prompt ubatch's GDN K-snapshot slots and conv history already hold the state at n-4, so the server's n-4 checkpoint batch cut could be replaced by a snapshot-slot copy into the checkpoint with no kernel change (intake-2772#record).

- [ ] **AK-GAP-1-STOCH-CENSUS** [inference] Census the temperature-1 speculative recipe on C17: split the inter-graph host share of the 27B DFlash2 :8083 recipe at temp 1.0, top-p 0.95, top-k 20 into logits copy-out, host sampling and the accept loop with the ak-gap-1-step1 tooling, because LLAMA_DEVICE_ACCEPT covers the greedy path only (intake-2755#record).

- [ ] **AK-GAP-1-STOCH-ACCEPT** [inference] Build a default-off device stochastic accept for temperature > 0 speculative verify on gfx90a: apply temperature, top-p and min-p in logit space to the TOPK_FAST candidates, run the rejection test with pre-drawn uniforms passed as a graph input, emit accepted count and the residual-resampled token, with the host path as the oracle, then A/B it (intake-2755#record).

- [ ] **Q38FN-CPU-SAMPLER-SPLIT** [inference] Attribute the non-forward share of the Q38FN CPU MTP round (sampler top-k and sort, drafter, host bookkeeping) with one perf timestamp pass, and port a tile-local packed-key AVX-512 top-k with deterministic tie order only if the sampler is >= 3% of the round (intake-2755#record).

- [ ] **TOC-CMP-4-PREREG-V2** [non-inference] Amend the TOC-CMP-4 pre-registration with the CompAct-Bench controls and two new arms before the next run: pre-filter points to tasks solved in all uncompacted repeats, a matched post-boundary action budget, retention-ratio matching with a self-built IRC calibration at a 10% character target, a no-history no-summary persistence-floor arm, 25/50/75% boundary placement, the six-type error annotation on failed continuations, a prose-only plus frozen append-only summary arm run in a progressive indexed form (fixed-size segments summarised as they close, each summary appended after the unchanged prefix and never rewritten; not blocked on kv-prefix-fork P1), a per-arm prefix-cache reuse tally (cached prompt tokens over prompt tokens from the slot logs) recorded beside accuracy and cost, and an async compaction plus next-k judge arm blocked on kv-prefix-fork P1 (intake-2762#record, intake-2778#record, intake-2761#record, intake-2770#record, intake-2786#record).

- [ ] **TOC-CMP-NONPROSE-TALLY** [non-inference] Tally, over existing trajectory artifacts, the share of context tokens that are non-prose (file, shell, SQL, test output) versus prose per role, to size the prose-only compaction arm (intake-2761#record).

- [ ] **TOC-CMP-JUDGE-SHIM** [non-inference] Write a llama-server judge shim for compaction validation: port Slipstream's V2-Fast alignment and non-contradiction judge prompt with a GBNF single-integer grammar and enable_thinking false, and test it offline on our own retained compaction transcripts (intake-2779#record).

- [ ] **TOC-CMP-SMALL-JUDGE** [inference] Evaluate a 2-3B local judge against the main model as the TOC-CMP-3g post-fold gate evaluator on our retained compaction transcripts, using the judge shim (intake-2770#record).

- [ ] **KPF-18.4** [non-inference] Measure the overlap-depth distribution the orchestrator actually produces (per-role n_fork_tokens over prompt length from the prefix index and /slots logs), solve the sparse-prefix checkpoint-placement DP offline for M in {1, 2, 4, 8}, and compare expected recompute against checkpoint_at=[len(trunk)] and dense-every-U (intake-2767#record).

- [ ] **KPF-22-QUEUE-SHARE** [non-inference] From existing SharedKVPoolAdmission logs, measure the fraction of request latency spent queued and the head-of-line blocked share under real fan-out, which is the precondition for any queue-time compaction (intake-2761#record).

- [ ] **KPF-RS-1-ZERO-STATE** [non-inference] Add a zero-state control arm (hybrid recurrent state zeroed, attention KV kept) to the KPF-RS-1 and KPF-18 restore tests, so the restore detector is shown to fire on a gross state error as well as a stale-state mutation (intake-2766#record).

- [ ] **KPF-RS-1-REFUSED-CTR** [non-inference] Add a refused-rollback counter to the server (count of seq_rm rollbacks refused by the rs_max guards c7435cc77 and 3a6fd54ae) and report it in /slots, so the next np 4 DFlash2 row shows whether the guard ever fires on served traffic (intake-2752#record).

- [ ] **KPF-62-DRIFT-PRIORS** [non-inference] Add two arms and a prior to the KPF-62 phase-0 hybrid drift-curve gate spec: a single-source arm (last chunk end-state, no transition matrix) beside the affine (A,B) and naive arms, and a head-window sweep w in {4, 8, 16, 32, 64} against the W=64 default, all scored by KLD and top-1, with HyPIC's layer-wise drift recorded as the expected magnitude and a first-divergent-layer localisation step modelled on HyPIC's diag_layer_divergence.py run on our ggml_gated_delta_net path (intake-2773#record, intake-2774#record, intake-2783#record).

- [ ] **SPEC-CONF-FRONTIER-GAP** [non-inference] Add frontier gap (1 minus the summed target probability over the drafted candidates at the first rejected position) as a fifth predictor in the SPEC-CONF.1 step-1 AUC logging, beside position, CAFE-3 EMA, top-1 and cumulative product (intake-2759#record).

proposed_tasks.task_text: - [ ] **SPEC-STALE-1** [non-inference] Port two upstream spec-accept fixes to a fresh llama.cpp-experimental branch from champion eee3da8, one feature per commit (intake-2803#record, intake-2811#record, intake-2799#record): (a) stop accepting draft tokens at an EOG that is not the last draft token in all three accept loops of common/sampling.cpp (plain ~:708, greedy-fast ~:928, rejection ~:960-1035; #29638 + philippesic ed1254a shape); (b) when a stop string or n_predict ends generation inside an accepted draft, trim the tokens after the stop from slot.prompt.tokens and the memory once per round (#32771 shape) using OUR use_ckpt_tgt (server-context.cpp:5976, n_rollback-based). Tests: unit test {eog,eog}->1, {eog}->2; the 48-EOG ngram tail case from #28232; an EOG at accepted row 0 on the checkpoint-restore round must terminate in one extra round; spec-on vs spec-off tokens_cached parity over 20 stop words on DFlash2 and MTP types, -np 1 and -np 2. No inference row unless the parity test shows stale tokens on our accept path.

- [ ] **PFXC-SAVE-1** [non-inference] Price the prompt-cache save path from evidence we already have before any port (intake-2800#record, intake-2823#record, intake-2809#record, intake-2810#record): (1) read the retained LLAMA_LB7_PROBES lines (alloc_us, idle_save_us, n_ranges, checkpoint-list size, prompt_save/prompt_load ms) for :8083 and :8070 and report P50/P95 save and restore ms and their share of TTFT; (2) read /proc/<pid>/smaps AnonHugePages for one live :8083 server during a served window (read-only); (3) grep launchers and stack configs for GGML_NOHUGEPAGE_PROCESS=1. Then decide: if save P95 >= 50 ms or >= 1% of the TTFT tail, open the port box (upstream #30137 reference-counted checkpoints + no-zero-fill buffers + #32758's restore-retry fix, with checkpoint accounting deduped by pointer); otherwise close as no-gain. THP flag and glibc.malloc.hugetlb are not adopted (host THP is `always`).

- [ ] **FOLD-GUARD-H12** [non-inference] Upstream-fold guard for our FA slots (intake-2808#record, intake-2818#record): at the next fresh-from-champion fold that crosses upstream #27970 (8e93a9773) or the fused TOP_K_MASK work, (a) move our FA op_params n_seq from slot 4 to slot 5 behind the accessor (readers fattn-gqa-verify.cu:682/:739, fattn-common.cuh:1079, ggml-cpu/ops.cpp:10428 @ eee3da8) and (b) add a test that asserts H12 still fuses the Q38FN QSA node with n_kv_max set and with the fused top-k-mask op present, failing loudly instead of silently falling back to dense FA.

- [ ] **FOLD-CENSUS-1** [non-inference] Conflict census for the next upstream bundle fold, before any fold branch is cut (intake-2816#record, intake-2795#record): run a merge-tree census of upstream #32016 (DFlash split into dflash/dflash2/dspark/lilicorr, merge 32bdc3a89) against our dflash.cpp/speculative.cpp fork commits (DFlash2 0262f0f92/8f609e10d, sinks d0f9fab7b, NVFP4 f7cbe3a35, per-token rows affe1097f, LiLiCorr c5c61e5ab, DS41 990213088) and record the plan (fold #32016 whole, re-apply features per head class, gate on greedy drafted/accepted identity at np1/np4 for 27B DFlash2 and the DS41 GGUF); record that upstream #30846 (660be5506) rewrites mul_mat_one_chunk and collides with our Q8_0 nrc==2 branch (ggml-cpu.c:1414-1418), so the fold needs an explicit resolution plus a test-backend-ops MUL_MAT Q8_0 n=2/4/8 bit-equality check; audit launchers for --spec-type values that #32016 starts refusing (draft-dspark on a DFlash2 GGUF disables speculation silently); and (operator question 2026-11-22) for each censused upstream change -- the DFlash split into dflash/dflash2/dspark/lilicorr, and the fused TOP_K_MASK work #30640/#30965/#31243 -- state with evidence whether we would GAIN from adopting it or whether our own path (DFlash2, H12 fused QSA) is faster.

- [ ] **AK-ISA-FAMILIES** [non-inference] Add fattn_vec, fattn_tile and classifier families for the gqa-verify (gv_*) and qsa-sparse (k_qsa_sparse_*) kernels to the gfx90a_isa_audit default family set and to the pre-timing ISA gate invocation, so a VGPR increase or occupancy drop in the served decode/verify FA kernels fails before timing; add to AK actor guidance that a feature bit in an FA hot loop must be a template parameter, not a runtime branch (upstream #32740 measured ~25% loss and 181->202 registers for the runtime-branch form on NVIDIA) (intake-2797#record).

- [ ] **GDN-VERIFY-BASE** [inference] Measure the recurrent GATED_DELTA_NET op on ROCm0 at verify shapes (F32 and bf16 state, S_v 128 and 64, H*n_seqs 48x1 and 48x4, n_tokens 1/4/8/16, 3 repeats, A/A floor) to supply the missing verify-regime GDN share, and port upstream #32456's mild-gate (g_min -0.05) GATED_DELTA_NET test cases into the fork's test-backend-ops set (intake-2796#record).
